d:
The Nuggets defeated the Bulls, 151-145 tonight in Chicago. Jamal Murray contributed a team-high 45 points to go with 7 assists 6 three pointers and 5 rebounds, with Nikola Jokić of the Nuggets adding an additional 37 points (14-22 FG, 1-3 3P) in the game. Buddy Hield finished with a team-high 33 points along with 7 rebounds for the Bulls in the losing effort. The Nuggets improve their record to 10-5 with the win, while the Bulls fall to 4-12 for the season.
